• Protection keeps running in the background and is restored after reboot.
• Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yandex SafeSearch and YouTube Restricted mode are enforced at DNS level — they cannot be turned off from browser/app settings while protection is ON.
• For maximum reliability, turn on “Always-On VPN” for Riy in Android VPN settings.
• Only DNS traffic is filtered — nothing is decrypted or inspected.
